why: Серія «Carver problems», тригер ASMR-стружки з відео про скобель на 39,6 млн переглядів. Мета: широке охоплення й переведення в заявки за словом CARVE.
rules: Show BeaverCraft products (kits, knives, finished figures) in the first seconds. Wood carving only — no other crafts (no straw, weaving, painting), no stone or marble sculpture, no clay. Prefer BeaverCraft's own carving footage (hands carving wood, kits being opened, finished figures) over stock; no random stock people who are not carving wood. No text over faces.

problems: Frames 2-4 show a guy in a workshop spraying shavings with a rasp on a plank, not clearly BeaverCraft products or hand carving, and it looks like generic woodworking
Frames 3 and 4 are near-identical, so the middle drags
Hook text and subtitle boxes stack and the hook caption covers the hands and part of the tool in the first frame
First second shows a tool and blurry hands, not a clear BeaverCraft knife, kit or finished figure
Final two frames are identical static end cards with the same text for about 3 seconds
qa.fix: Open with the finished gnome figure and a BeaverCraft knife cutting wood, replace the workshop rasp clips with close-up hand carving footage, and shorten the end card to one frame with the CARVE call to action.
